title: Assembling ordinary direct image and its component Hom bijection
statement: For compatible towers B_n,F_n and specified algebraic inverse images I_n along a finite-limit-preserving set-sheaf left adjoint L⊣V, suppose an OrdinaryInverseSystem P as in [lem-coef-ordinary-inverse-system] is given. Suppose each I_n.modules has a right adjoint V_n, an underlying-sheaf comparison to V, and the normalization that its linear transpose forgets to the given set-sheaf transpose, as in [lem-coef-normalized-module-adjunction]. Then there is a functor push on the actual sequence-site module categories with components V_n, whose evaluation identifications are identity on section carriers. There is a bijection between maps P.pull(M)→N and maps M→push(N). Under evaluation and the two component identifications this bijection is the specified level adjunction Hom bijection, precomposed with the inverse pull evaluation. No naturality, system adjunction, additivity or unit equation is assumed as a conclusion here: these are derived in the parent proof from the displayed component formula.

theorem ordinaryDirectSystem_exists [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv]
    (hI : ∀ n,
      uInv.map ((sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{max c v r})).map (τ n)) ≫
          (I n).ringUnderlying.hom =
        (I (n + 1)).ringUnderlying.hom ≫
          (sheafCompose J' (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{max c v r})).map (σ n))
    (uPush : Sheaf J' (Type (max c v r)) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type (max c v r)))
    (adjSet : uInv ⊣ uPush)
    (eV : ∀ n, V n ⋙ underlying.{c, v, r} J (B n) ≅
      underlying.{c, v, r} J' (F n) ⋙ uPush)
    (ha : ∀ n (M : Mod.{c, v, max c v r} J (B n))
      (N : Mod.{c, v, max c v r} J' (F n)) (f : (I n).modules.obj M ⟶ N),
      (underlying.{c, v, r} J (B n)).map ((a n).homEquiv M N f) ≫ (eV n).hom.app N =
        adjSet.homEquiv _ _ ((I n).moduleUnderlying.inv.app M ≫
          (underlying.{c, v, r} J' (F n)).map f)) :
    Nonempty (OrdinaryDirectSystem.{c, v, r} J B τ J' uInv F σ I P V a)
